title: OpenAI partners with Schibsted Media Group
summary: OpenAI and Schibsted Media Group announce content partnership to bring Guardian news and archive content to ChatGPT.
body: OpenAI and Schibsted Media Group announce content partnership to bring Guardian news and archive content to ChatGPT.
summaryZh: OpenAI与Schibsted Media Group宣布建立内容合作伙伴关系，将来自《卫报》及相关档案的新闻内容引入ChatGPT平台，丰富大模型的知识库和实时检索内容来源。原始信息显示：OpenAI and Schibsted Media Group announce content partnership to bring Guardian news and archive content to ChatGPT.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI partners with Schibsted Media Group”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI与Schibsted Media Group达成内容合作，将新闻内容引入ChatGPT。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
